description: Findings whose proposed status change was considered and rejected by the register. Each entry names the register row (or evidence) that refutes the finding — never a bare ignore list.

rejections.rationale: The register correctly refuted T212's PROVEN proposal. CODE.WZO2-INCOMPLETE (2026-08-02) established by direct scan that ~6.77M of ~48.6M passes=1 entries are missing; oracle self-play ends W+2 against a root of L=+1 H=+16. The WZO2-4X4-VALID row in CLAIMS.md records the reasoning: 'passing every check we had did not make the artifact valid, because no check we had tested completeness.' This is one of the project's better epistemic moments (GRAND-AUDIT §5).
